info.description: Where something is, as a picture or as an embedded map.

__.note: Admin metadata for this schema. Strapi ignores this key; src/this/admin-metadata reads it and writes it into the content manager's stored configuration on every boot. Latitude and longitude are hidden: they are read out of the place URL by the `derive-map-coordinates` document middleware on every save, so anything typed into them would be overwritten by the next one.

edit.label: Place URL
edit.description: Open Google Maps in a browser, search for the place or click the map to drop a pin on it, and copy the address out of the browser's own address bar. A short link from the Share button — maps.app.goo.gl/… — will not work here, because it says nothing about where the place is and this server cannot reach Google to ask: paste it into a new browser tab first, wait for it to land on the map, and copy the longer address the address bar then shows.

edit.label: Latitude
edit.description: Read out of the place URL on every save.

edit.label: Longitude
edit.description: Read out of the place URL on every save.

edit.label: Zoom
edit.description: How much ground the map shows around the pin. 16 is close enough to read the street names; lower is further away.

edit.label: Image
edit.description: A drawn or photographed map. Fill this in and the page makes no request to Google at all; leave it empty and a Google Map is embedded, which loads their scripts and sets their cookies before the visitor has done anything.
